The Modern Book Co., 357 Szechuen Road, is 
a Chinese-owned concern, having half of above address 
as its shop. This portion of the address faces 
onto Szechuen Road whilst the rear portion, which 
faces onto Central Arcade, is used by the French 
Book Co. It is believed by Russian detectives of 
both S.M.P. and French Forces that the proprietor of 
the French Book Store is Mrs. Chilikin, wife of V.A. 
Chilikin, proprietor and editor of the "Nowosti Dnia." 
When the address was visited by D.S.I. Young on the. 
afternoon of 3rd September 1940 and Mrs. Chilikin 
interviewed, however, she stated that the owner of the 
business is a French citizen named F. Cason Bonardel. 
She was accordingly requested to ask Mr. Bonardel to 
communicate with D.S.I. Young.

Date Mar. 26, '41.

（印：File No. ... / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / Special Branch / Station 374 / No. N. / Date 26/3/41 / H）

Subject (in full) Seizure of "Love" - A volume edited by D. H. Lawrence

Made by... D.S.I. Young Forwarded by... Supt. Mason

Perusal having shown it to be unfit for public sale, thirteen copies of above work were seized at the Modern Book Co's. distribution office on 24.3.41 and will be destroyed.

Whilst visiting other book shops in search of this work, 2 copies each of "Lady Chatterley's Lover" and "Ideal Marriage" were found at the New China Book Co., Central Arcade, and confiscated.

Both these books were previously proscribed.

A. C. (Special Branch).

R. A. Young.
D. S. I.

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

Item No.43 on the list contained in report
dated September 4, 1940, namely "Sexual Life of Savages"
has now been published and examination by this office
revealed that whilst it contains matter of a sexual
nature, it is treated in a serious scientific manner
which cannot be objected to.

D. C. (Special Branch).

Date Sept. 24, 1940.

Subject Far Eastern Book Company - Examination of books

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

On the morning of September 20th, 1940, a visit was paid to the Far Eastern Book Company's Sales Shop at 104 Central Arcade when a copy of a version of Lawrence's "Lady Chatterley's Lover" published by them was taken for examination.

A copy of "Yama the Pitt" was found in the shop and it was learned that it formed the last of three sent on consignment by the Modern Book Company, the other two having been sold. Seized copy is at present in S. 5 office.

The copy of "Lady Chatterley's Lover" is marked boldly on the front cover 'unabridged edition' but perusal proved it to be actually the abridged version.

D. C. (Special Branch).

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.5, Special Branch, Shanghai.
REPORT
Date Sept. 12, 1940.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SP. BR. REGISTRY / 374）

Subject: Modern Book Co. - Salacious Books

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

The Modern Book Co., 357 Szechuen Road, was visited on 5.9.40 when copies of all volumes listed on report dated 4.9.40, with the exception of "Sexual Life of Savages" and "Sexual Relations of Mankind," which are not yet published, were taken to S. 5 office for examination. A further two volumes, "Sex Life in France" and James Joyce's "Ulysses" were also taken for examination.

Examination of the volumes showed the following four to be of a lewd nature and unfit for public sale:-
"Ulysses" by James Joyce
"Lady Chatterley's Lover" by D.H. Lawrence
"Yama the Pit" by Alexandre Kuprin
"Ideal Marriage" by Th. H. Van De Velde

On the morning of 12.9.40 Mr. Y.T. Koo, Assistant Manager of the Modern Book Co., called at this office when it was explained that the four volumes mentioned were unfit for local sale.

In regard to "Ulysses" Mr. Koo stated it was published by a Tientsin firm and he had only a few copies on consignment.

He readily agreed not to display or offer this for sale either of the other three books, but asked that they be not seized as he needed them for filling outport orders.

D. C. (Special Branch).
D. S. I. （签名：D. S. I. Young）

（左侧手写批注：I cannot agree to not seizing these books. The fact that they are not intended for local sale is disproved by advt. in the X.C.M.G. at 8 pm. 11/9.）
（底部手写批注：If he does not Surrender Voluntarily we must obtain a Search Warrant. Rdy 12/9.）

主题：现代图书公司 - 淫秽书籍

1940年9月5日，走访了位于四川路357号的现代图书公司，除尚未出版的《野蛮人的性生活》和《人类的性关系》外，1940年9月4日报告中列出的所有卷册均被带至 S. 5 办公室进行检查。另有两卷，《法国的性生活》和詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《尤利西斯》也被带走检查。

经检查，以下四卷被认定为淫秽性质，不宜公开销售：-
詹姆斯·乔伊斯著《尤利西斯》
D.H.劳伦斯著《查泰莱夫人的情人》
亚历山大·库普林著《雅玛地狱》
Th. H. Van De Velde 著《理想的婚姻》

1940年9月12日上午，现代图书公司副经理 Y.T. Koo 先生来到本处，向其解释上述四卷不宜在本地销售。

关于《尤利西斯》，Koo 先生称该书由天津一家公司出版，他仅有少量寄售库存。

他 readily 同意不再陈列或出售这三本书中的任何一本，但请求不要查扣，因为他需要这些书来履行外地订单。

D. C. （特务科）。
副巡官（D. S. I.） （签名：D. S. I. Young）

（左侧手写批注：我不能同意不查扣这些书籍。它们并非仅用于外地销售的事实，被9月11日晚8点在《新华日报》（X.C.M.G.）上的广告所驳斥。）
（底部手写批注：如果他不自愿交出，我们必须申请搜查令。就绪 12/9。）

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY 374 66.40 Sept. 4, 1940）
Date Sept. 4, 1940

Subject Modern Book Co. Fall Catalogue 1940

Made by D.S.I. Young Forwarded by Supt. Mason

The Modern Book Co., 357 Szechuen Road, is a Chinese-owned concern, having half of above address as its shop. This portion of the address faces onto Szechuen Road whilst the rear portion, which faces onto Central Arcade, is used by the French Book Co. It is believed by Russian detectives of both S.M.P. and French Forces that the proprietor of the French Book Store is Mrs. Chilikin, wife of V.A. Chilikin, proprietor and editor of the "Novosti Dnia." When the address was visited by D.S.I. Young on the afternoon of 3rd September 1940 and Mrs. Chilikin interviewed, however, she stated that the owner of the business is a French citizen named F. Cason Bonardel. She was accordingly requested to ask Mr. Bonardel to communicate with D.S.I. Young.
